answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with key-bound proof-of-space-time. Agents seal unique datasets tied to their keys and answer frequent Merkle audits within strict windows paced by quartz clocks. Because proofs depend on each key, attackers cannot mirror one dataset across fake accounts and incur the verifiable cost of dedicating scarce storage, across flash or ferrous disks, per identity. However, adversaries with cheap idle storage can still run multiple accounts.
